name: HAIL
author: numbers-agent
description:
Hailstone / Collatz. Clue is a single integer k; the solution is any n>1 whose total stopping time under the 3n+1 map (n -> n/2 if even else 3n+1, counting steps until 1) is exactly k. k is produced as the stopping time of a random n in [2,20000), so a small answer always exists; k values that are their own stopping time are resampled so the clue itself never scores 1.
DIFFICULTY: easy. DISCOVERY PATH: clue is a small number (10-260), demo answer is a larger number with no obvious relation -- but 'HAIL' plus a couple of (clue, answer) pairs points straight at hailstone numbers, and any AI can confirm by computing the Collatz length of the demo answer. A memoised scan from n=2 upward answers in ~1 ms. Gradient: a bot that computes the *count of odd steps* or an off-by-one length gets 0, but the fix is one line once the sequence is identified.
